results.controlIntent: a. Develop, document, and maintain under configuration control, a current baseline configuration of the system; and b. Review and update the baseline configuration of the system: 1. [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]; 2. When required due to [Assignment: organization-defined circumstances]; and 3. When system components are installed or upgraded.

judgment.rationale:
CM-2 requires: (a) a current baseline configuration that is documented and maintained under configuration control, and (b) periodic review and update of that baseline at a defined frequency, when defined circumstances arise, and when components are installed or upgraded.

Evidence retrieved shows:
1. **Single version only (v1)**: The model registry entry (id: 9d318088) shows modelPackageVersion=1 with a creation time of 2025-11-30 and approval on 2025-12-01. There is no evidence of any subsequent baseline revision, update, or versioned change history — indicating the baseline has never been reviewed or updated since initial creation.
2. **No documented review schedule**: Neither the registry entry nor the endpoint config (id: 96f0bf18) contains any reference to a review frequency, review policy, or defined circumstances that would trigger a baseline update.
3. **Data capture disabled**: The endpoint config shows dataCaptureEnabled=false and capturePercentage=0. This eliminates a key operational signal (inference drift, data distribution shift) that would normally trigger a baseline review under CM-2.b.2 ("when required due to defined circumstances").
4. **No network isolation**: enableNetworkIsolation=false is a configuration detail present in the baseline, but there is no evidence this setting has been reviewed or is under change control.
5. **No configuration management artifacts**: There is no evidence of IaC templates, SCM-tracked configuration files, change logs, or CM policies governing this model/endpoint.

Taken together, while a baseline configuration exists (the model is deployed and approved), it shows no signs of being maintained under configuration control, reviewed on a schedule, or updated in response to system changes — failing CM-2.a (maintenance under config control) and CM-2.b (review and update requirements).
gaps: No evidence of a defined baseline review frequency or schedule (CM-2.b.1)
No evidence of defined circumstances that trigger baseline updates (CM-2.b.2)
No change log or version history beyond v1 to demonstrate ongoing configuration control (CM-2.a)
Data capture is disabled — no operational telemetry to detect drift-triggered review needs
No IaC, SCM, or configuration management tooling artifacts available for review
No human-attested policy documents describing the CM program for this model/endpoint
No evidence of what actions are taken when the model or endpoint components are upgraded (CM-2.b.3)
